verdict.rationale: Twilio is API-first: its products can be driven directly over HTTPS or through SDKs in several languages, with no UI needed, including REST APIs for phone-number purchasing and regulatory bundles. Community users corroborate unattended use, such as small SMS automations and voicemail-to-webhook pipelines. Missing for 10: no evidence of an official CLI, no CI-specific guidance (e.g., pipeline examples), and no documentation of non-interactive credentials such as API keys or service accounts.
